criterionIndex.criterion: Baseline evidence intact: all 345 manifest entries match; formal summary is 10 controls / 10 expected baseline failures / 0 setup faults (coordinator recount; original 9/11 headline preserved)
Unchanged baseline driver on the candidate (detached host, --job-exit-code 3762750553): every requirement and control passes; every expected baseline failure flips
Compatible enclosing job via the existing --launcher-host job option (driver libuv job: kill-on-close, silent breakaway)
Compatible explicit enclosing job (kill-on-close, no breakaway, no UI limits, verified nestable from inside): nested helper succeeds; helper tree is a member of the enclosing job

Helper owns a private kill-on-close job assigned at creation: every helper root is already in a job at its first witnessed instruction (handshake); detached, PowerShell-created and nested descendants are collected with it
Selected 15,000 ms initial work cap: deadline refusals return helper-timeout after the full window and within 15 s + 2 s + slack
Two-second cleanup allowance and explicit termination code 0xE0470459 whenever the launcher terminates its job
Both EOFs and zero active processes required for success; ordinary short-lived members (pipe-holding and no-pipe) quiesce inside the window
Caller stdio is never held by the helper tree (explicit handle list: NUL stdin and two private pipe writers only)

Creator death at acknowledged points (helper-ready; root-exited with descendants ready): exact launcher handle terminated, harness job held open, helper tree ends within 2 s by the private job, before any harness teardown
Job accounting with observer handles retained and after they close (open harness job; the private job's own accounting is launcher self-observation)

Incompatible enclosing job (in-job probe: nested and plain creation refused with 1816): refusal before the first helper exists, actionable helper-containment diagnostic, unrelated sentinel and job sibling survive
Warm click on an incompatible host refuses even with a live matching gateway; the existing gateway stays directly callable
Outer job with a verified effective UI restriction that prevents nesting
Concurrent drain: unread-stderr deadlock removed (1 MiB stderr flood then valid result succeeds); stderr is discarded and never forwarded
Stdout retention capped at 256 KiB: exactly 262,144 bytes accepted; 262,145 refused helper-invalid; oversize from a running root refused inside the work window with job termination
Strict UTF-8 and complete stage-protocol validation inside the work window (helper-invalid)

Held retry reserve: stalled recheck keeps the held reason and full advice inside the release wait; no recheck or unbudgeted final query when the 2 s reserve cannot fit the measured sample; clean held-to-free start
Closed outcome taxonomy observed natively: helper-containment, helper-unavailable, helper-timeout, helper-refused (natural nonzero, child exit retained), helper-invalid
Stderr privacy: synthetic sentinel never reaches launcher stdout/stderr, launcher.log(.1) or gateway.log; diagnostics carry no exception text
Gateway independence: separate detached launch survives its launcher, warm reuse keeps the same PID, caller EOF prompt, untouched by helper cleanup
Sentinel survival: the same-executable sentinel (also the WMI-queried process) and unrelated job siblings survive every case
Real unmodified API/helper and WMI controls: direct identity/free/held outputs, cold gateway start, warm reuse, held refusal for a live owner

Maintained native control NativeChecks --helper-checks (unmodified, compiled into scratch): clean, slow, flood, short-member, invalid/oversize/nonzero/perpetual-flood outcomes, four stream modes cleanup-confirmed with 0xE0470459, four sequential 5 s probes refuse at the 15 s cap
helper-cleanup-unconfirmed at the 2 s expiry and transfer of SafeHandle/OVERLAPPED/event/buffer to a completion owner
Full decision-point precedence (cleanup-unconfirmed, retained held guidance, expired work, natural nonzero, invalid)

Other containment setup-failure branches: CreateJobObject/SetInformationJobObject, attribute-list, pipe ACL/creation/connect, client-PID mismatch, remote-client rejection, EntryPointNotFound on pre-Windows 10; atomic assignment before user code
Staged installation validates attribute capability before replacing configuration or shortcuts

Native dialog rendering, concurrent clicks, oversized/flood diagnostics in the dialog, Windows Server and fresh-runner hosts, replacement-owner lock identity, store-acquiring/store-unverified via the launcher, real-WMI mismatch/missing/unverified identities
First-WMI-after-boot (cold WMI) measurement
WMI service and provider sessions stay outside the helper job
